notes:
Full-depth fan-out: family "Rust refoundation — R0–R11: reconciliation, evidence, oracles, cutover". Scene ids derive from the bound record paths; glyph terms are the bound records' own heading words. Presentation mappings are declared craft. Not corpus-complete claims beyond the frozen inventory: see the product receipt fulldepth-receipt-2026-09-21.md for exclusions and census-delta notes.

Enrichment 2026-10-06. Moves: the tranche arc runs basis→oracle→(owner return, retirement)→core→evidence→realised→actuality→observation: R0/R1 evidence and R2/R3 evidence gather (corpora accumulate); R0 basis and R1 oracle hold (source-locked, frozen authority); R10 turns (the physical return circles back to the owner machine, vortex); R11 ruptures (repel/shove — a layer retired); R2 core and R5 adapters hold (constitutional core, observation boundary); R3 runtime emerges ('one actuality, not a second harness'); R4 marks — Attributable→actuality→durable→continuity walks its own title, with the slowest speed LFO in the lane (durable continuity breathes slowly); R5 evidence settles (provenance at rest), source→evidence→provenance walking the chain.

3D on R5-ADAPTERS: z is the observation boundary's depth — body and relations nearest, attributable native occurrences deepest (the record's own boundary listing). Pointers across the arc: gather → hold → hold → vortex → rupture → hold → gather → gather → emerge → mark → hold → settle.
